wedge: 서울 공공서비스예약의 공개 예약 목록 + 인기 체육/캠핑 시설의 접수 시작일·상태 변화 + 개인이 선택한 종목/권역 => 예약 매크로가 아니라 '언제 어떤 예약이 열리는지'를 한 화면/캘린더로 정리하고 합법적인 오픈 타이밍을 알려주는 소비자용 레이더; 실제 예약·자동클릭·로그인·자리 선점은 하지 않음.
last_material_result: Fresh data+action discovery selected Seoul Public Reservation Opening Radar as the first survivor after the apartment-fee KILL. Demand signal is unusually concrete: 2026-06 reporting says Seoul blocked 2.61 million suspected macro accesses over the prior year and describes public tennis/camping/swimming bookings as click-war scarce inventory; earlier reporting also identifies tennis as a repeated pain point. Supply/data feasibility is promising: Seoul's public-service-reservation dataset covers roughly 13,000 annual services across city/district/affiliates, exposes service IDs and direct reservation URLs, and current catalog metadata indicates a free JSON Open API with CORS and a 1,000-request/day limit. The wedge deliberately avoids automated booking, which Seoul actively detects/blocks, and instead turns fragmented opening dates/statuses into a legal reminder/calendar layer. Key unresolved risk: the public API may expose listing/recruitment state but not sufficiently timely cancellation-slot inventory, so this iteration does NOT claim cancellation alerts.
economics: KRW0 validation spend. Data acquisition appears feasible on the free Seoul Open Data API tier. Best initial monetization is ad-supported SEO pages plus optional low-priced premium multi-facility calendar/alerts only if repeat demand is proven; likely micro-asset economics rather than high ARPU. Maintenance can stay low if driven from official structured data. Main risk is notification infrastructure cost/complexity versus modest consumer willingness to pay.
next_checkpoint: Next Lane C run: inspect the official Seoul public-service-reservation API fields/current sample payload to verify whether reception start/end timestamps and live status are reliable enough for an opening-calendar MVP. Then search for existing consumer apps/bots that already provide cross-facility opening reminders. KILL if the API lacks actionable timing/state or a dominant free reminder product already covers it; otherwise advance to VALIDATE with a zero-spend demand/distribution test. Do not expand into auto-booking or macro behavior.
recommendation: KEEP / ASSESS one more bounded iteration. Validate official field-level data and substitute coverage before any build request.
